description: Golden 64x64 RGBA8 desktop-internal idle-clock pixels. Generated by executing the canonical reference renderer D:/Desarrollo/gentle-emotex/src/idle_clock_image.ts (Node type stripping) at deterministic fixed-offset instants with transparentBackground=true. The canonical animation step Math.floor(nowMs/1000) was fed a 2x scaled instant so it equals the approved desktop cadence Math.floor(epoch_ms/500); glyph drawing always used the real instant and its fixed offset. Each rgbaBase64 decodes to 64*64*4 row-major unpremultiplied RGBA8 bytes: ink pixels opaque, background gaps transparent (the desktop paints its own backdrop).
